title: Pharmaco-informatics screening of Zingiber officinale biomolecules targeting FOXO6 for chronic kidney disease therapy.
authors: Kabilan, Shanmugampillai Jeyarajaguru; Kunjiappan, Selvaraj; Pavadai, Parasuraman; Sankaranarayanan, Murugesan; Sundar, Krishnan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选姜生物活性分子靶向FOXO6治疗慢性肾病，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Ginger, scientifically known as Zingiber officinale, is a plant root that has a variety of therapeutic applications, including the treatment of nausea, inflammation, digestive problems, and management of renal function in chronic kidney disease (CKD). CKD is a life-threatening condition that, if untreated, leads to organ damage and is acknowledged as a global health concern. The present study aims at predicting bioactive compounds from Z. officinale that were identified through gas chromatography-mass spectroscopy (GC-MS), with the potential against a selected target of CKD, and was investigated using a pharmaco-informatics approach. METHODS: The compounds from GC-MS analysis were screened, and the structures of identified compounds were drawn through ACD/Chemsketch 2021.2.1. Based on graph theoretical network analysis, forkhead box protein (FOXO6) was chosen as a potential target for CKD. The Swiss model was used to predict the structure of FOXO6, and the active site details were obtained. Docking was performed against the active sites of FOXO6 using 22 compounds, along with the standard drug, dapagliflozin. Pharmacokinetic, physicochemical and toxicity parameters were predicted for the selected high binders and dapagliflozin. The stability and intermolecular interactions of high binders and dapagliflozin protein-ligand complexes were studied using molecular dynamics simulation. RESULTS: The binding affinity ranges from -3.5 to -6.7 kcal x mol(-1). Abietic acid and dehydroabietic acid had a higher binding affinity with a score of -6.7 kcal x mol(-1), similar to the standard drug, dapagliflozin (-6.4 kcal x mol(-1)). Both abietic acid and dehydroabietic acid also have good bioavailability scores. MD simulation studies indicated greater stability for abietic acid-FOXO6 and dehydroabietic acid-FOXO6 complexes. CONCLUSIONS: This investigation has shed light on the significance of the compounds of Z. officinale R. as potential FOXO6 inhibitors, which could further be used as a lead compound for developing alternative therapy for CKD.
abstract_zh: 目的：生姜（学名Zingiber officinale）是一种植物根茎，具有多种治疗应用，包括治疗恶心、炎症、消化问题以及管理慢性肾病（chronic kidney disease, CKD）中的肾功能。CKD是一种危及生命的疾病，若不治疗会导致器官损伤，并被公认为全球健康问题。本研究旨在通过气相色谱-质谱联用（gas chromatography-mass spectroscopy, GC-MS）鉴定生姜中的生物活性化合物，并利用药物信息学方法评估其对CKD选定靶点的潜在作用。方法：对GC-MS分析得到的化合物进行筛选，并通过ACD/Chemsketch 2021.2.1绘制已鉴定化合物的结构。基于图论网络分析，选择叉头框蛋白（forkhead box protein, FOXO6）作为CKD的潜在靶点。使用Swiss模型预测FOXO6的结构，并获取活性位点详细信息。使用22种化合物以及标准药物达格列净（dapagliflozin）对FOXO6的活性位点进行对接。对选定的高结合力化合物和达格列净预测了药代动力学、理化性质和毒性参数。通过分子动力学模拟研究了高结合力化合物和达格列净蛋白-配体复合物的稳定性和分子间相互作用。结果：结合亲和力范围为-3.5至-6.7 kcal x mol(-1)。松香酸（abietic acid）和脱氢松香酸（dehydroabietic acid）具有较高的结合亲和力，得分为-6.7 kcal x mol(-1)，与标准药物达格列净（-6.4 kcal x mol(-1)）相似。松香酸和脱氢松香酸也具有良好的生物利用度评分。MD模拟研究表明，松香酸-FOXO6和脱氢松香酸-FOXO6复合物具有更高的稳定性。结论：本研究揭示了生姜化合物作为潜在FOXO6抑制剂的重要性，这些化合物可进一步用作开发CKD替代疗法的先导化合物。
